probes.summary: All three backend Nginx endpoint checks passed.
HAProxy configuration matched live backend addresses and distributed successful requests across all three backends.
Required role-specific web/proxy state was clean across all nodes.
limitations: No reboot was authorized by the authored plan, so reboot persistence was not directly exercised.

assertions.summary: Node1 active Nginx returned HTTP 200 with exact body node1.

evidence.command:
svc=$(systemctl is-active nginx 2>/dev/null || true); printf 'nginx_active=%s
' "$svc"; curl -sS --max-time 5 --write-out '
HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}
' http://127.0.0.1:5660/

assertions.summary: Node4 HAProxy was active, its configuration was valid, and it returned successful HTTP on port 80.

evidence.command:
printf 'haproxy_active=%s
' "$(systemctl is-active haproxy 2>/dev/null || true)"; printf 'unit_execstart:
'; systemctl show -p ExecStart --value haproxy 2>/dev/null || true; printf 'config_check:
'; sudo -n haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg; printf 'config_directives:
'; sudo -n awk '/^[[:space:]]*(frontend|backend|listen|bind|server|default_backend)[[:space:]]/ {print NR ":" $0}' /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg; printf 'requests:
'; i=1; while [ "$i" -le 12 ]; do printf 'request_%s=' "$i"; curl -sS --max-time 5 --write-out ' status=%{http_code}
' http://127.0.0.1:80/; i=$((i + 1)); done
evidence.observation: exit_code=0; haproxy_active=active; Configuration file is valid; sampled requests returned successful HTTP 200 responses.

'; ip -4 -o addr show scope global; printf 'resolver_entry:
'; getent ahostsv4 "$NODE_NAME" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {print $1, $5}'

overall_summary: All six authored assertions pass. Reboot persistence was not directly tested because no reboot probe was authorized.
